name: outcut-share
title: Outcut Share
description: Control Outcut Share: share regions and presets, pause, record, switch follow and share modes.
author: fwin

commands.name: select-region
commands.title: Select Region & Share
commands.description: Start the drag-selection overlay (or the Virtual Monitor when that share mode is active).

commands.name: share-preset
commands.title: Share Preset
commands.description: Pick a saved region preset and share it.

commands.name: toggle-pause
commands.title: Pause / Resume Sharing
commands.description: Freeze or blur what viewers see.

commands.name: toggle-recording
commands.title: Start / Stop Recording
commands.description: Record the shared region to an .mp4.

commands.name: set-follow-mode
commands.title: Set Follow Mode
commands.description: Region follows the active window, the cursor, or nothing.

commands.name: set-share-mode
commands.title: Set Share Mode
commands.description: Hidden Window, Virtual Display or Virtual Monitor (applies while not sharing).

commands.name: toggle-preview
commands.title: Toggle Preview Window
commands.description: Show or hide the floating viewers-see-this panel.

commands.name: toggle-hotbar
commands.title: Toggle Hotbar
commands.description: Show or hide the floating quick-action bar.

commands.name: toggle-cursor-highlights
commands.title: Toggle Cursor Highlights
commands.description: Cursor halo and click ripples for viewers.

commands.name: toggle-dimming
commands.title: Toggle Dimming
commands.description: Dim everything outside the region locally.
